description: This file defines a class 'Adapters' used to load and handle Adapter components in Android applications via XML configuration. It includes nested classes and interfaces for binding cursor data to views, data transformations, and parsing XML adapter definitions. The class facilitates dynamic creation and management of adapters, especially cursor-based adapters, with support for custom data binding and transformations.

classes.name: Adapters
classes.description: Main class providing static methods for loading and managing adapters defined via XML in Android, including nested classes and interfaces for data binding, transformation, and parsing.

classes.name: Adapters.CursorBinder
classes.description: Interface for binding cursor data to views, supporting custom binding logic.

classes.name: Adapters.CursorTransformation
classes.description: Abstract class for transforming cursor data before binding to views.

classes.name: Adapters.XmlCursorAdapter
classes.description: Implementation of a cursor adapter, extending SimpleCursorAdapter, supporting XML-based configuration and dynamic data loading.

classes.name: Adapters.IdentityTransformation
classes.description: Default transformation that returns cursor data as-is.

classes.name: Adapters.ExpressionTransformation
classes.description: Transforms cursor data based on a string expression with embedded placeholders for column values.

classes.name: Adapters.MapTransformation
classes.description: Transforms cursor data by mapping specific string values to other strings or resource IDs.

classes.name: Adapters.StringBinder
classes.description: Binds String data from cursor to TextView.

classes.name: Adapters.ImageBinder
classes.description: Binds blob image data from cursor to ImageView.

classes.name: Adapters.TagBinder
classes.description: Binds cursor string data to a View's tag.

classes.name: Adapters.ImageUriBinder
classes.description: Binds URI string from cursor to ImageView.

classes.name: Adapters.DrawableBinder
classes.description: Binds drawable resource ID from cursor to ImageView.

classes.name: Adapters.ManagedAdapter
classes.description: Interface for adapters that require asynchronous loading.

classes.name: Adapters.QueryTask
classes.description: AsyncTask to perform cursor queries in the background for XmlCursorAdapter.

methods.name: loadCursorAdapter
methods.description: Loads a CursorAdapter from XML resource, configured via content URI.

methods.name: loadCursorAdapter
methods.description: Loads a CursorAdapter from XML using an existing Cursor.

methods.name: loadAdapter
methods.description: Loads an adapter from XML resource, returning a BaseAdapter.
